svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Hub-spoke network on Azure
svg.desc: Hub-spoke network on Azure. 13 components in 11 groups. Connections: Corporate servers to Edge router; Edge router to ExpressRoute circuit (private peering); ExpressRoute circuit to ExpressRoute gateway; Edge router to VPN gateway (IPsec tunnel); ExpressRoute gateway to Azure Firewall; VPN gateway to Azure Firewall; vnet-hub 10.0.0.0/16 to vnet-spoke-app 10.1.0.0/16 (peering); vnet-hub 10.0.0.0/16 to vnet-spoke-data 10.2.0.0/16 (peering); Azure Firewall to Log Analytics (diagnostics); Virtual machines to Private endpoint; Private endpoint to Azure SQL Database; Private endpoint to Private DNS zone (A record).

text.tspan: On-premises reaches two peered spoke networks through the hub's gateways and Azure Firewall, over ExpressRoute with a VPN backup
